title: Page 5
content_zh:
“刘伯，我没事。”刘掌柜的关心让汪袭绿原本冰凉的心滑过了一丝暖意，嗓音也不自觉柔和了许多。终究是娘亲为她留下的人，不似这府里上下百余人，有一半都是口不对心，拜高踩低的。

这世上除了红串和半屏，也只有刘伯是真正关心自己的吧，可惜的是，自己的心中事，又怎么可能说给刘伯听呢？更何况说了又如何，打她嫁进来的那一刻起，她便注定了深陷泥淖之中，进退不得。

虽然她可以在心底不再将褚靖南当成她的夫君，心便能得自由，但到底还是被关在这四四方方的院子里，轻易不得出去。

摇了摇头，汪袭绿连忙咽去心头又突然窜起的苦涩，她率先走进偏厅，安安稳稳的落坐。

因为褚靖南还在拥雪院里当大爷，汪袭绿知道自己不能耽搁太久，才缓了口气便说起了正事，“刘伯，我今日让半屏去找你，是想问问，若是我要脱手那几间铺子，多快可以办到？”

此话一出，在场几人全都面面相觑，红串和半屏甚至有些惊慌失措。

要知道，这几间铺子可是能生钱的，有钱使的她们在褚家就已经有些施展不开了，若是再没了铺子，只怕寸步难行，那些人还不知道会怎样折腾她们。

“那些铺子不能卖啊！”半屏的脑子向来转得快，红串还没回过神来，她已经先一步的惊呼道。

“怎么不能卖了？”汪袭绿淡淡的反问。

不过是些死物，有什么能不能的？只要能助她达成想要的，便是要卖去所有的铺子，她也舍得。

“那些是夫人留下来让主子傍身的，怎么能卖了呢？”

这几间铺子都是极好的铺面，每年都能让主子得到将近一万两的利钱，别看这府里家大业大的，可在金钱上却不是很充足，这一年多来，主子贴进去的银两可不少。

汪袭绿看着神情紧张的三人，开怀的笑了，这是她嫁进褚家这一年来，露出的第一个发自真心的笑容，很轻松、很真实。

“今日我们能卖掉那些铺子，终有一日我一定能买回它们，若是咱们想要离开褚家，身无分文可不行。”

初时，只是一晃而过的念头，而后那个念头在她心里迅速生了根，快速的成长，前后不到一个时辰的时间，她已经下定了决心，说起话来彷佛已经思索这件事许久了似的。

既然褚靖南怎么都瞧她不顺眼，又不肯真心相对，难不成她就得像她娘一样枯守着这四四方方的院子吗？

闻言，红串和半屏嘶地倒抽了一口凉气，惊骇得说不出话来。

刘掌柜还算见多了大风大浪，连忙收拢心中的震惊，问道：“少夫人想要和离？”

“褚家不会愿意和离，就算是要让他休了我，只怕他们也丢不起这个脸，更何况上头还有一个老将军镇着，我是老太爷定下的亲，老太爷虽然不太插手我们夫妻之间的事，也不可能眼睁睁的看着我被休离。”

这也是他们虽然看她不顺眼，却不敢真的将她赶出府的原因，这一年来她虽不说，却早已将一切都看在了眼底。

“少夫人是怎么盘算的？”刘掌柜追问。虽然少夫人表现得那样气定神闲，可他仍无法放心。

如此一个进退两难的局面，只怕能生生的将人熬死，当初小姐不就是这么熬没的吗？

想着想着，他终于忍不住大着胆子抬头，想瞧瞧小主子的神色，只见她苍白的脸庞带着一股子的沉稳，彷佛一切都已胸有成竹，他原本担忧不已的心这才稍稍地定了下来。

这一年来，他倒是真的了解小主子的性子，她比早逝的小姐精明许多，行事手段亦不柔弱可欺，这点从她嫁进褚家，虽然处境艰难，但也一直让人寻不着错处便可以瞧得出来。

“你先别管我怎么盘算的，你要做的便是尽早将我名下的店铺都盘了出去，价格不拘，愈快愈好。”汪袭绿沉声交代，然后很满意地瞧着刘掌柜再无二话的接受了自己的命令。

“少夫人！”半屏低喊一声，毫不掩饰她的忧心。

半屏和红串的表情更为紧张焦虑了，她们总是劝主子要拿出当家主母的气势，教训一下那些作威作福的小妾通房们，却没想到事情的发展和她们预期的完全不一样。

汪袭绿扫了两个丫鬟一眼，便知道她们想要说什么，当下也不让她们多言，而是交代道：“这事我自有主张，你们放心，断不会连累了你们。你们两个去安排一下，今晚大少爷要待在咱们院子里，咱们可得好生款待款待。”

主意已定，汪袭绿也不再纠结，语气之间反而还带着些许兴味，只要想着褚靖南留宿她的院子、和她相处融洽的消息传了出去，他的那些莺莺燕燕会怎样的跳脚，她的心便是一阵的舒坦。

故意的吗？

当然是，俗话说浑水摸鱼，从现在开始，褚家得要愈乱愈好，她才能够得到她想要的契机，从此离开这里。

褚靖南想到他很少在拥雪院用膳，因为心中对汪袭绿的厌恶，总觉得她出身粗俗，这里的菜肴必定也很粗俗，所以他总是拖到院门要落锁的时间才过来。

认真说起来，这倒是这一年来他第一回这么早就待在这儿，还有机会能在这儿用膳，本以为也不会有什么特别的东西，可是看着陆陆续续从小厨房端出来的小菜佳肴，倒让他惊讶了。

光是澄掬蟹这道小点，精致的程度连有些称得上名号的大酒楼都做不出来，还有那道香酥肘子，光是一瞧那软烂香酥的模样，便教人食指大动，比其他几个院子里的吃食还要精致许多。

就在饭菜渐渐摆满了一桌子时，褚靖南终于瞧见汪袭绿出现，只见她接过丫鬟递过去的巾帕仔细地擦了手，这才在他的对面坐下。

成亲以来头一回在她的院子里吃饭，她便这样大剌剌的坐着，难道她不知道她该先伺候他用膳吗？

这是规矩，无论他在哪个院子用膳，那些女人们无不欢欢喜喜的把他伺候得很周到，她却这般随兴，让他心中有些气堵，说了她嘛，好像自己小家子气，可是不说她嘛，又觉得自己不受尊重。

汪袭绿看着今天这样丰富的菜色，抬头扫了一眼管着小厨房的红串，似有责怪，但却也只是一眼，什么都没说便垂下了眼，她也不晓得褚靖南心中的千回百转，端起了碗，说道：“爷，用膳吧。”说完，她便认真的开始吃饭。

也还好像他们这种自诩高贵的人吃饭，都讲究食不语，所以她自是乐得安安静静的吃饭，也懒得招呼他，连替他夹个菜都没有。

对他再无期望，亦无要求，所以她也不再勉强自己做他们眼中那种温良恭俭让的贤妻，她自在了。在心态略略修正过后，不再疲惫的她胃口大开，尤其是今儿红串那丫头八成是想要多讨褚靖南的欢心，不惜成本，还费着劲的做出这些色香味俱全的菜肴，让她吃得过瘾极了。

她吃饭的速度不快，但很专注，那模样就像即使天就要塌下来了，她也得好好的把饭给吃完才行。

察觉到她的眼中只有食物而没有自己，不知怎地，褚靖南心底窜过一丝火气，原本捧着的碗重重地放在了桌上。

汪袭绿正吃得开心，因为嫁过来这么久，她总是殚精竭虑的想着要如何才能将褚家操持得更好，所以别说睡得少，便是连吃东西也是匆匆。
content_en:
"Uncle Liu, I'm fine." Shopkeeper Liu's concern brought warmth to Wang Xilu's originally cold heart, and his voice became softer unconsciously.After all, it was the person left by her mother for her, unlike the hundreds of people in this house, half of whom were dishonest and worshiped others.

In this world, apart from the red string and the half-screen, only Uncle Liu really cares about him. Unfortunately, how can he tell Uncle Liu what is on his mind?What's more, no matter what was said, from the moment she got married, she was destined to be stuck in the quagmire, unable to advance or retreat.

Although she could no longer regard Chu Jingnan as her husband in her heart and her heart could be free, in the end she was still locked up in this square yard and could not get out easily.

Shaking her head, Wang Xilu quickly swallowed the bitterness that suddenly arose in her heart. She took the lead in walking into the side hall and sat down safely.

Because Chu Jingnan was still the uncle in Yongxue Courtyard, Wang Xilu knew that he could not delay for too long, so he took a breath and got down to business, "Uncle Liu, I asked Ban Ping to find you today because I wanted to ask, if I want to sell off those shops, how quickly can I do it?"

As soon as these words came out, everyone present looked at each other, Hong Chuan and Ban screen were even a little panicked.

You know, these shops can make money. If they have money, they can't do anything in the Chu family. If there are no shops anymore, it will be difficult to move forward. Those people don't know what they will do to them.

"Those shops can't be sold!" Ban Ping's mind was always spinning fast, and Hong Chuan had already exclaimed before Hong Chuan could recover.

"Why can't it be sold?" Wang Xilu asked calmly.

They're just dead things, what can't be done?As long as it helps her achieve what she wants, she is willing to sell all the shops.

"Those were left by the lady for the master to keep with her, how can they be sold?"

These shops are all excellent shops, and the master can get nearly 10,000 taels of interest every year. Although the family in this mansion has a big business, they are not very rich in money. Over the past year, the master has put in a lot of money.

Wang Xilu looked at the nervous three people and smiled heartily. This was the first sincere smile she had shown in the year since she married into the Chu family. It was very relaxed and real.

"We can sell those shops today, and I will definitely be able to buy them back one day. If we want to leave the Chu family, we have to be penniless."

At first, it was just a passing thought, but then the thought quickly took root in her heart and grew rapidly. In less than an hour, she had made up her mind and spoke as if she had been thinking about this matter for a long time.

Since Chu Jingnan always dislikes her and refuses to treat her sincerely, is it possible that she has to guard this square courtyard like her mother?

Hearing this, Hong Chuan and Ban Ping gasped, too horrified to speak.

Shopkeeper Liu had seen enough storms and waves, so he quickly put away the shock in his heart and asked: "Young Madam, do you want to make peace?"

"The Chu family won't be willing to reconcile. Even if they ask him to divorce me, I'm afraid they can't afford to lose face. What's more, there is an old general guarding me. I was married by the old lady. Although the old lady doesn't interfere in the affairs between our husband and wife, he can't just watch me being divorced."

This was also the reason why they didn't dare to really drive her out of the house even though they didn't like her. Although she didn't say anything this year, she had already seen everything.

"What is the young lady's plan?" Shopkeeper Liu asked.Although the young lady acted so calm and composed, he still couldn't rest assured.

Such a dilemma would probably bring someone to death. Isn't that how the young lady endured it in the first place?

After thinking about it, he finally couldn't help but dared to raise his head to see his little mistress's expression. He saw a calmness on her pale face, as if everything was already known, and his worried heart finally calmed down a little.

Over the past year, he has really understood the temperament of his young mistress. She is much smarter than the young lady who died young, and her methods are not weak and cannot be bullied. This can be seen from the fact that she married into the Chu family. Although she was in a difficult situation, she never found fault.

"Don't worry about my plans. What you have to do is to sell out all the stores under my name as soon as possible. The price is arbitrary, the sooner the better." Wang Xilu said in a deep voice, and then watched with satisfaction as Shopkeeper Liu accepted his order without a word.

"Young Madam!" Banping shouted in a low voice, not hiding her worry.

Ban Ping and Hong Chuan's expressions became even more nervous and anxious. They always advised their master to show off their mistress-like attitude and teach the domineering concubines a lesson, but they did not expect that things would develop completely differently from what they expected.

Wang Xilu glanced at the two maids and knew what they wanted to say. He didn't let them say anything at the moment, but explained: "I have my own opinion on this matter. Don't worry, I won't cause any trouble for you. You two go and make arrangements. The eldest young master will stay in our yard tonight, and we will have a good time entertaining him."

The decision was made, Wang Xilu no longer hesitated, but there was still a little interest in his tone. As long as the news spread that Chu Jingnan was staying in her yard and getting along well with her, and what kind of jumps he would make, her heart felt comfortable for a while.

On purpose?

Of course, as the saying goes, fishing in troubled waters should be fishy in troubled waters. From now on, the Chu family will have to be as chaotic as possible, so that she can get the opportunity she wants and leave here.

Chu Jingnan thought that he rarely ate in Yongxue Courtyard because he hated Wang Xilu in his heart and always felt that since she was from a vulgar family, the food here must also be vulgar, so he always delayed coming over until the courtyard door was about to be locked.

Seriously speaking, this was the first time in the year that he stayed here so early and had the opportunity to eat here. He thought there would be nothing special, but he was surprised when he saw the side dishes and delicacies being brought out from the small kitchen one after another.

Just the small dish of crab, which is so delicate that even some famous restaurants can't make it. There is also the crispy pork elbow. Just looking at the soft and crispy appearance will make people move their index fingers. It is much more exquisite than the food in several other courtyards.

When the table was gradually filled with food, Chu Jingnan finally saw Wang Xilu appear. She took the towel handed over by the maid and wiped her hands carefully before sitting down opposite him.

It was the first time since they got married that they had dinner in her yard, and she was sitting there in such an awkward manner. Didn't she know that she should wait for him to eat first?

This was a rule. No matter which courtyard he ate in, the women would happily serve him attentively. However, she was so casual, which made him feel a little angry. If he talked about her, it seemed like he was a petty person, but if he didn't talk about her, he felt disrespected.

Wang Xilu looked at the rich dishes today and glanced up at Hong Chuan who was in charge of the small kitchen. She seemed to blame him, but she only glanced at it and lowered her eyes without saying anything. She didn't know what was going on in Chu Jingnan's heart. She picked up the bowl and said, "Master, let's have a meal." After that, she started to eat seriously.

It also seemed that people like them, who regarded themselves as noble, were very particular about eating in silence, so she was happy to eat in peace and didn't bother to greet him, not even picking up a dish for him.

She no longer had any expectations or requirements for him, so she no longer forced herself to be the gentle, respectful and thrifty wife they thought she was. She was now at ease.After a slight correction of her mentality, she was no longer tired and had a huge appetite, especially since that girl Hong Chuan most likely wanted to please Chu Jingnan more, regardless of the cost, and worked hard to make these dishes with full color, flavor and taste, which made her enjoy the meal.

She didn't eat very fast, but she was very focused, as if even if the sky was about to fall, she had to finish her meal properly.

Realizing that she only had food in her eyes and not herself, Chu Jingnan somehow felt a trace of anger in his heart and placed the bowl he was holding heavily on the table.

Wang Xilu was eating happily. Because she had been married for so long, she was always thinking hard about how to manage the Chu family better, so not to mention not sleeping much, she even ate in a hurry.
